description: Changes one setting of how videos look, for the workspace's default or, with project_id, for one site on top of it. action set gives the setting a value; action clear takes the choice back, so the videos follow the workspace, or the usual. get_video_style lists the settings and what each accepts. Only owners and admins can change them. It is one of Gene's small edits, so the person's CodeGene settings decide: if they let small edits happen on their own it is changed at once and the answer says done, with how to undo it in CodeGene; otherwise nothing changes until the person approves it. The answer then gives a link to the request, which waits there for 15 minutes: send the person that link, you cannot approve it, then call get_approval with the requestId to learn how it ended. Videos made from now on use the change; videos already made stay as they are.

action.description: set gives the setting a value; clear takes the choice back.

project_id.description: The site, to change its own choice (list_projects gives ids). Leave out to change the workspace's default.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

value.description: With set: one of the choices get_video_style lists, or the text. Leave out with clear.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: change_video_style
title: Change how videos look
